color tokens resolve differently under `dark.a` and `win hct`, which is
exactly why you use the token instead of the value.

Names map 1:1 from Figma variables: `color/primary/primaryHover` becomes
`--color-primary-primary-hover`. Names are EXACT — do not guess by analogy.

## `--elevation-*`

```css
--elevation-0: 0 1px 2px 0 var(--color-elevation-drop-shadow-light),
    0 0 4px 0 var(--color-elevation-drop-shadow-heavy);
--elevation-1: 0 1px 4px 0 var(--color-elevation-drop-shadow-light),
    0 1px 8px 0 var(--color-elevation-drop-shadow-heavy);
--elevation-2: 0 2px 8px 0 var(--color-elevation-drop-shadow-light),
    0 2px 16px 0 var(--color-elevation-drop-shadow-heavy);
--elevation-3: 0 4px 12px 0 var(--color-elevation-drop-shadow-light),
    0 3px 24px 0 var(--color-elevation-drop-shadow-heavy);
--elevation-4: 0 6px 18px 0 var(--color-elevation-drop-shadow-light),
    0 4px 36px 0 var(--color-elevation-drop-shadow-heavy);
--elevation-5: 0 8px 24px 0 var(--color-elevation-drop-shadow-light),
    0 4px 48px 0 var(--color-elevation-drop-shadow-heavy);
--elevation-low: 0 1px 2px 0 var(--color-elevation-drop-shadow-light);
--elevation-high: 0 12px 32px -4px var(--color-elevation-drop-shadow-heavy);
```
